drafts.subject: Re: Guest lecture on agentic programming?
drafts.message:
Dear Professor Alvarez,

Thank you for reaching out and for your kind invitation. We are delighted to hear that your students are already experimenting with Jaseci—it is always encouraging to see the framework being explored in a graduate setting.

We would be glad to give a 60-minute guest lecture on agentic programming for your AI systems seminar. This is very much at the core of what Jaseci is built for, and we would be happy to tailor the session to your students' level of familiarity. I can cover the foundations of the Jac language and its graph-based program structure, walk through building and orchestrating agents, and share some practical examples that build on what your students may already be working with.

Of the two proposed dates, September 22 works best on our end. A remote presentation at 2-4pm Eastern is perfectly fine for us. Please feel free to share any particular topics or use cases you would like emphasized, and we will do our best to incorporate them.

Thank you again for the opportunity, and we look forward to speaking with your seminar.

Best regards,
The Jaseci Team
impact@jaseci.org
